title: MSRR scenario deck
description: What we do to a plant: forcing schedules, horizons, solver, vehicle names. Array LENGTHS stay Modelica structural parameters; this file supplies values and documents those lengths. Enforced at load time by helpers.scenario_config (raw and merged) via helpers.data_validation (errors name the file and dotted path).

kind.description: Scenario family. Maps to data/scenarios/<dir>/. A runner's requested kind must match this value.

doc.description: Required on scenarios that do not extend a parent; overlay fragments inherit the parent's documentation.

extends.description: Optional same-kind parent scenario id; maps are deep-merged. Chains are cycle-checked and limited to 5 hops (helpers.scenario_config.MAX_EXTENDS_DEPTH); failures name the offending chain.

applies_to.description: Plant.core ids (plant id + '.' + core key), e.g. msrr.r1. The core key must belong to the deck's core roster (currently msrr.r1, msrr.r9, msrr.r1_10seg, msrr.r5x5_z10); runners enforce membership of the selected core at run time and record a deliberate --allow-unlisted-core override in the run provenance. The schema deliberately does not hard-code the roster.

package_support.description: legacy class names and whether segmented needs a generated wrapper (array-size change).

structural.description: Array lengths the emitter must write into a wrapper (numUhxSteps, numSourceSteps, …). Each value is coupled to the matching forcing schedule length.

poisons.description: Optional homogeneous poison controls. Default is tracking and feedback off.

initialization.description: Only steady_state is accepted; fixed_start is refused at load time by helpers.scenario_config.

forcing.description: Source, reactivity, UHX demand, pump ramps, sine. Not plant volumes.

amplitudes.description: Numbers or the 'S' (strength) placeholder; length must equal times_s.

amplitudes_n_s.description: Numbers or the 'S' (strength) placeholder; length must equal times_s.

amplitudes.description: Signed pcm amplitudes; length must equal times_s.

rampUpTime_s.description: Strictly increasing; length must equal numRampUp and rampUpK_s.

rampUpK_s.description: Positive time constants; length must equal rampUpTime_s.

cases.description: Named transient cases (step pcm, flow fraction, uhx_trip schedule). Runners load STEP_PCM / FLOW_CASES from this list; ids must be unique.

dollars.description: Dollar label of an insertion; runners apply it at each core's own nominal-flow 1 $ (helpers.circulation_dollar), and the case pcm records the reference (dollar_pcm.value) amplitude. Step rows use their own label; a flow row's label sets the size of its insertion (an unlabelled flow row inserts the step_1dol amplitude).

times_s.description: Strictly increasing; length must equal demand_W.

grid.description: Frequency sweep omega range and point count. CLI --freq_min/--num_freq overlay this when those flags are omitted.

omega.description: Explicit points; strictly increasing when more than one.

init.description: Setpoint row selection and per-core T overlay. Not the setpoint CSV.

display.description: Plot phase lines / windows. omc does not consume this.

scenarios.description: Campaign composition slots -> scenario ids (campaign kind).

vehicle.description: Committed SegmentedMSR.Demos.<name> demo vehicle class the deck runs (radial_demo kind). The SegmentedMSR.Demos prefix is enforced by name (helpers.scenario_config.RADIAL_DEMO_VEHICLE_PREFIX), and the deck's radial_config identity must EQUAL the vehicle's code-owned contract field by field (radial_demo_contract_mismatches) - a deck may not claim a dataset id, fingerprint, HX model, flow direction, or flow distribution the compiled vehicle does not bind.

maturity.description: Dataset maturity label (radial_demo kind). The loader requires exactly 'exploratory_geometry' (helpers.scenario_config.RADIAL_DEMO_MATURITY): demo vehicles carry SYNTHETIC placeholder geometry with no physical provenance - never a plant prediction.

radial_config.description: Structural radial/loop identity the deck claims (radial_demo kind). Keys are exactly the loader's _RADIAL_DEMO_RADIAL_KEYS vocabulary (unknown keys refused); the claimed identity must equal the named vehicle's code-owned contract (radial_demo_contract_mismatches).

enabled.description: radial_demo decks describe ENABLED stacks (a disabled run needs no radial_demo deck - the production vehicles stay disabled by default).

annular_heat_exchanger_model.description: Must be exactly 'finite_conductance_prescribed_sink' while annular_heat_exchanger_enabled=true and 'none' while false (the only implemented heat-exchanger model; the structural switch is the enabled boolean).

channel_flow_fractions.description: One fraction per annular-loop channel [1]; each >= 0, sum = 1 within 1e-6 (SegmentedMSR.Core.fracTol). Required in circulating mode; refused in static mode (static carries no loop distribution; plan §10.12).

radial_dataset_id.description: Non-empty identity of the committed demo dataset.

radial_maturity.description: Must be 'exploratory_geometry' (the committed synthetic demo datasets).

radial_fingerprint.description: Non-empty demo radial fingerprint; must equal the vehicle's derived digest.

annular_loop_fingerprint.description: Non-empty demo annular-loop fingerprint; must equal the vehicle's derived digest.

uhxDemand.description: Either a times_s + demand_W/amplitudes_W schedule (strictly increasing times, equal lengths, non-negative power) or a frac-form ramp.
